translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Apasol
book.title: APASOL Bi Jiysis Minim Dand Amemb Gok Yerer Giyak Kesim

content: Pol Kiyŋ Aŋgriypa Nup Minim Aŋgak
Pen kiyŋ Aŋgriypa Pol nup aŋgak, “Yand nip niŋsipiyn nen, minim aŋgan aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Pol ñin dand araniy aŋgak, “Kiyŋ Aŋgriypa. Nand nep apiy yip minim aŋgnimin aŋgey, Jiwda biynimb minim yip apay ak, nip aŋgniŋg gispiyn ak; yip tep gip.
Chin Jiwda biynimb gipun gipun ar ak nand maŋgiysek niŋban ak mey; nip nep aŋgniŋg gispiyn ak, yip tep gip. Kun ak minim aŋgen, yip yiruk ma niŋnimin.

“Jiwda biynimb Jerusalem nimb gok, yip kor gispay ak; Gor wosrey basind apis sikop kuyip minim tep aŋgek, gos sek kond mindyiŋgipay minim anep aŋgen, yip kor gispay. Pen yand bi key okok nimb rek, minim bap key aŋgnim: yand bi key okok nimb mer; bi Peresiy, Jiwda low minim niŋiy, asik tep yimb gipiyn bap. Ñiskoy miŋg mindiy, mind dand apiy, miñiy mindpiyn ñin biy, miñmon yand Tasas nimb, Jerusalem nimb gipiyn. Kun ak yip Peresiy aŋgiy niŋbay ak pen, minim kun ak weygiy, yip kor gispay.

“Nand niŋban: ‘Chin Jiwda biynimb gok kiñiŋ keykey onep wimiŋgan ak mindpun. Chin maŋgiysek, Gor basind apis sikop kuyip aŋgak minim tep ak kond mindpun. Nuk biynimb kumbay gok, gen tikjakniŋgambay aŋgak minim ak niŋmindiy, pumbnamb kisyimken, nup aŋgniŋyiŋg mindpun. Pen kiyŋ Aŋgriypa nand niŋan! Kumiy tip tikjakniŋgambun minim anep aŋgen, yip kor gipay!
Pen nimb yenen biynimb kumbay gok, Gor gek ma tikjakniŋgambay aŋgiy niŋbim?
“Pen yand key, nind Jiysis Nasaret nimb minim ak, yipund ma gip aŋgiy, Gor biynimb nuk gok kuyip, timey yimb giyiŋgipiyn.

Pen Jerusalem minden, Gor nup simboŋgep biyomb gok yip aŋgey, Jiysis ker mindeyak biynimb gok kuyip am dand apen, kalambis ayiŋgipay. Gunap pisnep pikayiŋgipay. Biynimb pikayiŋgipay gok kuyip panj aŋgyiŋgipiyn.

Jiwda nan-gep korip okok taŋgiy, biynimb Jiysis nup gosimb niŋyak gok kuyip niŋen, yip milukrimey yapek; minim kun ak kirginimimb aŋgiy, kuyip timey giyiŋgipiyn. Ñin gunap biynimb kun gok piyow niŋiyn aŋgiy, miñmon paryomb okok amyiŋgipiyn.
Pol Jiysis Nup Gosimb Niŋak Kesim
“Pen ñin bap Damaskas biynimb Jiysis nup gosimb niŋyak gok kuyip, miñ ay dand wiyn aŋgen, Gor nup simboŋgep biyomb gok yaw aŋgiy, minj tikñey, dand saŋdinik.
Pumbnamb yomb yoŋ won ak, kinjeŋnamb ak amyiŋg niŋnik; melik yomb ak semb biyoŋ nimb, chin amninuk ak niŋak. Biyomb niŋan! Melik niŋak kun ak, pumb melik rek mer; melik kun ak key yimb gak.

Kun gek, chin maŋgiysek apyap pikiy, yand niŋnik; minim bap, minim yimb chin Hiybriw minim aŋgiy, yip aŋgak, ‘Sol! Sol! Yip yenen per miluk niŋiy timey gipan? Nip per kinjeŋ tep yomiyn apiyn ak pen; yip timey gipan ak, nip key yiwur gisap aŋgak.’
Aŋgek, yand aŋgnik, ‘Biyomb nand an?’ Aŋgenik aŋgak, ‘Yand Biyomb Jiysis; yip per timey gipan ak nep aŋgak.’

Kun aŋgiy, yip aŋgak, ‘Tikjakan! Yand nip minim aŋgniŋg opiyn ak aŋgniŋg gispiyn. Nand woŋg yip ak giy, yip miñiy niŋban rek, pen kisen yomen niŋrep giniŋgamban rek, biynimb gunap kuyip aŋgñiniŋgamban.
Kun giy aŋgñiyiŋg taŋgnakniŋ, Jiwda biynimb gok sek, biynimb Jiwda mer gok sek nip timey giyakniŋ, kond mindeniŋgayn.

Kun ak biynimb kisyim wip okok mindpay gok, melik tep ak niŋniŋgambay. Seytan nup gos ak kirgiy, Bapiy gosimb chirupapiy anep niŋniŋgambay. Yip diniŋgambay kun ak, tap yerip yerip timey giyak gok, Bapiy niŋiy kirginiŋgamb. Nuk kuyip niŋek, biynimb yand nindnimb gok niŋek tep gip rek ak giniŋgamb aŋgak.’
Pol Gor Nup Woŋg Giyiŋgip Ak Aŋgñak
“Pen kiyŋ Aŋgriypa. Yand melik semb biyoŋ nimb apiy minim aŋgak kun ak, ma kirginik.

Damaskas amiy, biynimb kun okok kuyip Jiysis minim tep ak aŋgñinik. Kisen am Jerusalem biynimb kuyip aŋgñiy, Jiwdiya biynimb okok kuyip aŋgñiy, biynimb Jiwda mer miñmon okok aŋgñiy ginik. Kuyip aŋgñiy aŋgnik, ‘Tap siy tap timey gipim gok yenen kun gipun aŋgiy kirgiy, Gor nup gosimb nokom niŋiy, aŋgip rek ginimimb aŋgnik.’
Jiwda biynimb mer gok sek, minim kun ak aŋgñinik ak mey, kisen Gor aŋgniŋep korip ak amenik, Jiwda biynimb yip niŋiy mey pikayak.

Pen Gor yip kond nep mindip rek, minim tep nup ak, biynimb yimb mindip gok sek, biynimb yimb ma mindip gok sek aŋgñiyiŋg nep mindpiyn. Minim aŋgñimbiyn kun ak, ar bap key mer; binak Mosis sek, bi Gor minim aŋgep gunap sek aŋgyak rek nep aŋgñimbiyn.
Kiyk aŋgyak:

content.text: “Krays apiy, miker diyiŋg, kumiy tikjakniŋgamb ak mey; Jiwda biynimb gok sek, Jiwda biynimb mer gok sek kumiy, tikjakep kinjeŋ ak niŋniŋgambay aŋgyak.” ”

content: Pol minim kun ak aŋgakniŋ, biyomb Pestas minim yomb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Pol. Nand minim ar keykey layniym gipan rek, jun muk nip ak milip gek aspan aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Pol aŋgak, “Biyomb Pestas. Yip jun muk milip gek ma aspiyn; gos niŋyiŋg, minim niŋind yimb ak aspiyn.

Kiyŋ Aŋgriypa! Chin niŋiy gipun ar ak, nand niŋban ak mey, yand nip pirikiy ma asipiyn. Yand niŋbiyn: Jiysis nup yerer giyak ak weygiy ma giyak; miseŋ nep geyak niŋnak ak mey, tap bap ma niŋban mer; maŋgiysek niŋban.
“Nand bi Gor minim aŋgep gok, minim aŋgyak ak, niŋind aŋgyak aŋgiy, gos niŋban? Yand niŋen; nand niŋind apay aŋgiy niŋban rek ayip aŋgak.”
Pol kun aŋgek, kiyŋ Aŋgriypa aŋgak, “Pol. Nand yip, minim sikoy bap aŋgen, Jiysis binuk bap mindeŋ aŋgiy, yip minim kun ak aspan?”

Aŋgek, Pol aŋgak, “Minim paryomb aŋgiy akaŋ, minim maŋ won aŋgiy ma apiyn; yikop Gor nup aŋgniŋiy apiyn, “Nand sek, biynimb minim aŋgen niŋmindpay guniy sek yand mindpiyn rek, mindeniŋgiy aŋgiy apiyn. Pen yip sen aypay rek, kuyip ma ayniŋgiy aŋgiy apiyn.”

Pol kun aŋgek, biyomb Pestas ak, kiyŋ Aŋgriypa ak, nunay Baniys ak, biynimb mindeyak gok maŋgiysek mis tikjakiy aŋgyak, “Biynimb gok timey gey mey, kor giy, gunap kalambis ay, gunap pisnep pik ay gipay; pen bi biy tap timey bap ma gip aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgiy, kiyŋ Aŋgriypa, Pestas nup aŋgak, “Miñiy kalambis kirgiy mis ambikop ak pen; nuk Siysa kor yip niŋniŋgamb aŋgip ak mey, kalambis mindiy, biyomb Siysa mindip ak amniŋgamb aŋgak.”
